evaluation_policy: Same saved private state, trace/RNG/event queues and config; t=2403 to2703, original horizon3600 and period anchor unchanged. Serial round-robin one model action per arm. One unseeded model trajectory per cell. Equal per-arm60calls/3Mtokens/3600modelseconds/600secondspercall. Incomplete or failed arms not counted as savings. No automatic retries; new unknown usage freezes this cohort.
first_proposal_policy: Report first propose_delta/finalize attempt and first successful candidate_checked separately. Sum per-arm model duration through event; also report per-arm attempt and reported tokens through event. Wall timestamps include round-robin waiting and are not model latency.
memory_policy: Identical prior accepted selection_note; tool history and fact cache reset equally. Original fact_memory.py and two-read threshold unchanged. No efficiency feedback and no coverage guidance in any arm.
quality_policy: Compare complete common300seconds only: independently audit provenance, raw usage, physical prefix/opportunity; weighted tardiness, completed lots/production operations, ready queue area and production utilization. Short pilot cannot establish statistical noninferiority; require longer replicated experiments for deployment.

treatment_policy.filter_projection: Add model-selected numeric/set predicates; preserve all selected business values, entity IDs, source order, absent fields, paging coverage. Move repeated row provenance metadata to unchanged full tool-result artifact.
treatment_policy.interaction: Filtering/projection runs before offload threshold. Tool schema/descriptors are treatment differences; scheduling protocol text, original preview selection, cap, fact-memory gate and physical engine are identical.
treatment_policy.targeted_recovery: After normal lossless packing exceeds 12000 characters, retain original artifact and publish exact path index with bounded original-order preview. Add explicit current public facts locator and 1..32 batched exact-path field recovery. No extra summarizing model.
